evidence: Judge agent+model pinned and shared: task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx" via OpenRouter; all five judge.toml files carry only judge = "claude-code" (line 2) with no model/temperature/effort override; test.sh:63-66 refuses to grade (zero reward) if either variable is missing. Judge CLIs pinned: tests/Dockerfile:16-21 npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; tests/Dockerfile:31 pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. Browser pinned: tests/Dockerfile:33-38 installs Chromium via the Playwright CLI bundled inside @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, whose registry dependencies are exact (playwright and playwright-core '1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05', from npm view), so the Chromium revision is fixed; every judge.toml launches playwright-mcp with --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Shared tools are template-identical: CRLF-normalised diff of tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile against rules/projects/webdev-task-template shows no differences; task.toml differs only in identity/metadata lines 5-15, so [verifier], [verifier.env] and timeouts are the template's. Time rules: the only graded time rule is a relative 15-second live-update window (instruction.md:5, hireops_rules.md:117; functional judge.toml rows at lines ~290/299/335/344/353; polish judge.toml:23,32), measured from the judge's own action with an explicit procedure ('wait up to 15 seconds ... accept the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds', functional/prompt.md protocol V/U; polish prompt.md:14). No graded rule depends on the calendar date or run date (no overdue/expiry/'today' rules). Seed timestamps all lie in 2026-07-01..2026-07-29, so 'newest first' Activity (judge.toml:263) and message order are graded only over actions performed in the review and are stable for any run clock after July 2026. Open verifier network ([verifier.environment] network_mode="public", task.toml:37-38) and absence of temperature/prompt-version markers are explicitly not defects per workbook row 47 and SKILL.md Delivery profile; the Internal sheet's older wording (temperature 0, versioned prompt, no unpinned network) is superseded by the public row text and the delivery profile. Notes (non-blocking, template-controlled): base images node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag- not digest-pinned and rewardkit's transitive pip deps are unpinned; LLM judging remains inherently stochastic. These are shared-template choices and the row does not require them. Broken-app probe: an app that only refreshes on a long poll (>15 s) cannot pass the live-update rows because the window is measured from the judge's action, not wall-clock dates; a conforming app is not penalised by clock drift because no criterion compares against the run date. Run evidence: raw-evidence-index scope states no full configured judge run exists; the pinning is a static property verified from source, so the configured run is NOT EXERCISED for this row but is not a required measurement for it.
